results.generic_name: Drug-eluting percutaneous transluminal coronary angioplasty catheter
results.ao_statement: The SELUTION SLR 014 PTCA Drug-Eluting Balloon is intended to be used after appropriate vessel preparation in patients undergoing percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) in coronary arteries 2.25 mm to 4.50 mm in diameter and lesions <= 26 mm in length for the purpose of improving myocardial perfusion when treating in-stent restenosis (ISR).

openfda.device_name: Drug-Eluting Percutaneous Transluminal Coronary Angioplasty Catheter
